content: <h3><strong>In Short:</strong></h3> <p>The Senior Lead Footwear Costing Strategy &amp; Margin Governance is responsible for shaping the Brand’s footwear costing strategy and enterprise margin governance across the entire product creation lifecycle.<br>Acting as a strategic business partner to the creation leadership, the role drives cost transparency, margin optimization, and governance excellence by integrating product, innovation, sustainability, sourcing, and finance perspectives into executive decision-making.<br>Reporting to the Head of Footwear Costing, the Senior Lead is responsible to establishes the creation Costing operating model, governance standards, and strategic direction for footwear costing while enabling profitable and sustainable growth through fact-based decision making.</p> <h3><strong>Your Mission:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Shape and continuously evolve the Brand’s creation footwear costing strategy and&nbsp;operating model.</li> <li>Lead end-to-end margin governance from target margin setting through target FOB,&nbsp;product creation cross functions</li> <li>Supporting Costing governance frameworks, costing standards, decision rights, and best practices across the global footwear organization.</li> <li>Translate business strategy into actionable costing and profitability recommendations.</li> <li>Provide executive-level business cases and financial insights that support product investment, portfolio optimization, and long-term profitability.</li> <li>Own global costing methodologies, assumptions, tools, dashboards, and reporting&nbsp;standards.</li> <li>Drive digital transformation, automation, and continuous improvement of costing&nbsp;processes.</li> <li>Ensure data integrity, transparency, and a single source of truth for costing and margin reporting.</li> <li>Influence cross-functional leaders to align commercial ambition with financial performance.</li> <li>Coach and develop costing capability while strengthening financial litera

In this role, you will seamlessly connect the granular with the strategic—acting as a hands-on technical master of the details while serving as the high-level strategic consultant for On’s most critical category. By ensuring perfect alignment between design vision and manufacturing feasibility, you will set the standard for footwear creation. You will provide the technical governance, cross-functional leadership, and visionary support necessary to implement elite performance standards and protect product integrity.</p> <p>The Senior Lead Development role will report to the Head of Innovation Footwear, supporting the wider global footwear department.</p> <p><strong>Please Read Before Applying:</strong><br>To ensure a smooth and efficient recruitment process, we kindly ask all applicants to submit their CV in English, as this is the working language of our company.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Your Mission</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Technical Stewardship:</strong> Act as the primary technical advisor during the briefing and design phases to ensure performance running concepts are aligned with global manufacturing capabilities.</li> <li><strong>Strategic Synchronization: </strong>Facilitate technical alignment between Zurich-based Design/Product Management and the Asia-based execution teams, ensuring that the "performance soul" of the category is preserved across all franchises.</li> <li><strong>Process Enablement:</strong> Support the evolution of development standards by identifying technical bottlenecks and advising on best practices that improve category-wide efficiency.</li> <li><strong>Advisory &amp; Escalation Support:</strong> Serve as the senior technical point of contact for Asia-based development partners, providing guidance on complex technical hurdles and supporting the resolution of high-level production escalations.</li> <li><strong>Performance Quality Assurance:</strong> Support the validation of fit, fee

Establish clear, value-based discount structures, incentive programs, and commercial policies that drive mutual growth.</li> <li><strong>Omnichannel Governance:</strong> Direct and optimize inventory management across all distributor-led channels—including wholesale distribution networks, localized e-commerce platforms, and distributor-owned mono-brand retail stores.</li> <li><strong>Commercial Execution:</strong> Partner with distributors to manage daily account operations, including robust order book management, sell-in and sell-out tracking, and optimizing product assortment to ensure healthy inventory rotations.</li> <li><strong>Strategy Implementation:</strong> Support the Distributor Director in deploying the overarching LATAM &amp; CAC commercial strategy, ensuring a premium, consistent, and structured brand presence in all distributor-led territories.</li> <li><strong>Forecasting &amp; Planning:</strong> Drive category-level forecasting and bottom-up distribution planning across footwear, apparel, and accessories, aligning with product launch timelines and regional demand.</li> <li><strong>Market Intelligence:</strong> Conduct regular market, competitor, and distributor performance analyses to identify white-space opportunities, evaluate commerci
